programNotes.title: 学科专业简介
programNotes.text:
“数据科学与大数据技术”（国际项目），致力于培养具有全球竞争力的复合型人才。项目以国际化课程设置、跨文化学术交流为特色，使学生掌握数据科学前沿技术的同时，具备在多元文化环境中协同创新的能力。项目聚焦计算数学、统计学、计算机科学与行业应用的交叉融合，鼓励学生参与国际科研合作与产业实践，旨在造就一批精通专业技术、具有跨学科创新能力和国际视野的复合型大数据人才。
The program is dedicated to cultivating globally competitive composite talents through all-English lectures. The program features an international curriculum and cross-cultural academic exchanges, enabling students to master cutting-edge technologies in data science and at the same time have the ability to collaborate and innovate in a multicultural environment. The program focuses on the cross-fertilization of computational mathematics, statistics, computer science and industrial applications, and encourages students to participate in international scientific research cooperation and industrial practice, aiming to create a group of composite big data talents who are proficient in professional technology, have interdisciplinary innovation ability and international vision.

programNotes.title: 培养目标
programNotes.text: 本专业培养德智体美劳全面发展，具有良好的政治素质与道德修养，能够利用数据建模、分析与处理、统计推断的基本理论、方法和技能，从事大数据有关教学、科研、开发和应用的“复合型”人才。This program cultivates “composite” talents with all-round development in morality, intelligence, physicality,  and aesthetics, good political quality and moral cultivation, who are able to engage in the teaching, scientific research, development and application of big data by using the basic theories, methods and skills of data modeling, analysis and processing, and statistical inference.

programNotes.title: 基本要求
programNotes.text: 本专业要求学生掌握大数据相关的统计、计算机、数学和应用学科的基础知识，以及数据分析、技术开发和应用的基本技能。通过系统学习专业课程，培养既有严格的专业技术训练，又有深刻数据视野的数据科学人才和数据技术人才，满足大数据相关产业对基础人才的需求。This program requires students to master the basic knowledge of statistics, computer, mathematics and applied disciplines related to big data, as well as the basic skills of data analysis, technology development and application. Through systematic study of specialized courses, the program aims to cultivate data science talents and data technology talents who have both strict professional and technical training and profound data vision, and to meet the demand for basic talents in big data-related industries.

programNotes.title: 学分要求
programNotes.text: 专业进阶路径（143 学分）Regular Major Track (143 Credits)本路径学生需要完成 143 学分（含实践学分不低于 36 学分；含美育学分不少于2学分，其中至少在“美学和艺术史论类”或“艺术鉴赏和评论类”课程中修读1学分，并至少参与一项艺术实践活动；劳动教育不少于32学时，并满足劳动周教育要求），包括通识教育课程 40 学分、专业培养课程 66 学分、专业进阶模块 30 学分、融合创新能力模块 7 学分。Students in this program are required to complete a total of 143 credits, including no less than 36 practical credits, at least 2 aesthetic education credits (with a minimum of 1 credit from either "Aesthetics and Art History" or "Art Appreciation and Criticism" courses, plus participation in at least one art practice activity), and no fewer than 32 labor education hours while meeting the Labor Week requirements. The credit distribution consists of 40 general education credits, 66 core professional training credits, 30 advanced specialization module credits, and 7 integrated innovation capability module credits.
